text: How false, therefore, is the view of those who speak of the animal world as if nothing were to be seen in it but lions and hyenas plunging their bleeding teeth into the flesh of their victims! One might as well imagine that the whole of human life is nothing but a succession of war massacres.
author: Peter Kropotkin
reference: Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution
locator: Chapter II, Mutual Aid Among Animals (continued)
